title: Purdue motorsports engineering student Dylan White races from pit lane to  Halloween Hundred victory
summary_en: Dylan White, a Purdue University student majoring inmotorsports engineering, turned an unexpected setback into a first-place finish, driving the No. 72 Dynoco Racing kart to victory in the Purdue Grand Prix Foundation’s third annual Halloween Hundred on Oct. 17 at the Purdue Grand Prix Track.
